import subprocess,json
unit="prediction-a2z-v4-model@A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261007-R4P2.service"
p=subprocess.run(["systemctl","--user","show",unit,
 "-p","ActiveState","-p","SubState","-p","Result","-p","ExecMainStatus","-p","ExecMainCode",
 "-p","ActiveEnterTimestamp","-p","InactiveEnterTimestamp","-p","ExecMainStartTimestamp","-p","ExecMainExitTimestamp"],
 capture_output=True,text=True)
vals={}
for line in (p.stdout or "").splitlines():
    if "=" in line:
        k,v=line.split("=",1); vals[k]=v
print("ERROR_CLASS=R4P2_SERVICE_STATE",flush=True)
print("ERROR="+json.dumps(vals,separators=(",",":"),sort_keys=True),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(1)
